pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0126 Timeline and Sequencer
pr_body:
## Summary

Hardens the production Timeline contract before Project Rust and Sequencer integration. Multi-player composition has explicit priority with deterministic tie-breaks and diagnostics; Timeline events retain stable asset + semantic document identity; continuous Animation sampling no longer fabricates seek discontinuities; neutral loop semantics are exposed through the production runtime; and unsaved Editor working copies compile through the same runtime path.

The shared Timeline authoring service gains transactional duration, rename, typed clip-payload, and marker-event edits so the Sequencer does not bypass CLI/MCP-equivalent authoring semantics.

The PR remains Draft while Project Rust control, the dedicated Sequencer workspace, and final Windows/Visual Validation continue.
